title: Implement: Python oracle for Key Persistence
description: Write reference implementation in python/src/lichen/. Must be clear, readable, well-commented. Cover all MUST requirements.
close_reason:
Implemented Python oracle for key persistence in crypto/key_persistence.py. Includes:
1. KeyStore abstract class with crash-safe semantics
2. MemoryKeyStore for testing (not crash-safe)
3. FileKeyStore with two-slot crash-safe storage and 0600 file permissions (spec 15.2)
4. TrustStorePersistence for saving/loading TrustStore entries as JSON
5. Integration with Identity class via store_identity/load_identity methods
6. 24 tests covering all MUST requirements from spec 15.2

Existing implementations for TOFU support (trust.py), key-to-address derivation (identity.py), replay state management (protocols.py), and crash-safe DAO persistence (dao_persistence.py) were already complete.
